criteria.evidence: Swiss-technical logistics dossier: mono section counters 01-08 in navy chips straddling the band seams, hairline rules, ice-blue over near-white, no decoration.
Hierarchy is carried by weight and size, not hue: near-black heavy display headlines, mid-slate body, tiny mono eyebrows and row numerals; desaturating would lose nothing but the band tint.

The four-up bordered card row is used twice (the 'Что мы берём на себя' block and the 'Свои рефрижераторы' block), and the 'Нам доверяют' row is a five-up version of the same boxed shape; the numbered rule-row list also recurs in Услуги, География and Как мы работаем.
Hero is an asymmetric split: left-aligned display headline plus a two-column fact grid and two buttons on the left, a full-bleed-to-edge truck photo on the right, over a faint vertical column grid.
Two real truck photographs, each showing the FWL globe logo painted on the trailer and a legible Kazakh plate; the header lockup uses the FastWay wordmark.
The 'Нам доверяют' row renders DANONE, HAMLE, ШИНЛАЙН, AMERICANO and SAMAL as uppercase letterspaced text inside plain bordered boxes; no logo images anywhere.
No field, no selector, no quote or route picker; the only control on the page is the light/dark toggle in the header, and every other affordance is a WhatsApp or tel link.
The hero headline is genuinely huge and set tight over two lines, while the section counters, eyebrow 'СНГ · ЕВРОПА' and list numerals are genuinely tiny mono.
The whole palette is navy, ice blue and near-white; nothing violet, and no gradient wash anywhere.
No blobs, glows, mesh or abstract 3D; the only imagery is the two photographs.
Icons are drawn line marks — a chat bubble on the WhatsApp button, a handset on 'Позвонить', a sun on the theme toggle.
Navy appears only on the two primary buttons, the small section counter chips and the logo bar; it is never used to fill a section.
Every section sits on its own tinted band — pale blue and near-white alternate mechanically all the way down, with no dark, photographic or otherwise decided ground in 8 sections.
Besides cards the page owns numbered rule rows, a two-column origin→destination route table with arrows, an image-plus-list split for the second service, and a five-step label/description table.
Copy names ТР ТС 021/2011, the ATP certificate, FRC class, thermograph readings, Kazakhstan→Russia and Europe→CIS legs, and a real phone number +7 708 180 5200.
No lorem, no placeholder text, and the page carries no numeric stat block at all — nothing invented to check.
The closing 'Связаться' block ends with the same 'Написать в WhatsApp' button that sits in the header, plus a 'Позвонить' repeat; the only new element is the phone number set large.
Measure is held consistently, headline-to-body and section-to-section gaps are stable, and the hero leaves real air around the display type rather than filling it.
The counter chips notched into the band seams, the mono numerals and the route table are specific enough that it does not read as a recoloured purchase.
A studio would have to replace the typeset client names with real marks, break the two-tint banding, and stop the closing CTA duplicating the header before showing this.

defects.what: Client trust is claimed with five brand names typeset as letterspaced words in empty bordered boxes — including Danone — which reads as unfilled logo placeholders rather than evidence
Nothing on the page can be filled in or chosen; a carrier page that asks for route, cargo, regime and dates offers no field for any of them, only outbound WhatsApp and tel links
defects.where: whole page, most acutely the closing 'Связаться' block

defects.what: The page closes on a verbatim repeat of the header button pair instead of a new next step
Three boxed-row variants do most of the compositional work: the four-up card row appears twice and the trust row is a five-up of the same box
defects.where: the block above 'Услуги', section 03 'Свои рефрижераторы', section 05

defects.what: Two near-identical light blue tints alternate for the entire scroll; no dark ground, no photographic ground, so nothing marks arrival anywhere in a very long page
Photography stops after the services block — the lower two thirds of the page is type on flat tint, and the closing contact block has no image at all
Section intro paragraphs are held to a narrow left measure with the right half of the band left empty, which reads as leftover grid rather than a decided asymmetry
The faint vertical column grid is drawn in the hero and then never referenced again on the page

aesthetic_in_one_phrase: Swiss technical dossier for a cold chain — navy and ice blue, mono counters, hairline rules
